occupied_above_floor.1.0.0-rc.1: Withdrawn mistaken release of 2026-09-11. github.com/webgrip/ploeg@v1.0.0-rc.1 stays in the Go module proxy and checksum database, and ploegd and charts/ploeg 1.0.0-rc.1 stay on GHCR and Forgejo.

ploeg.retired: Since 2026-10-03 github.com/ploeg-hq/ploeg versions and publishes Ploeg, starting at 0.1.0 (system ADR-0019). The last Ploeg version Unfold published is 0.4.0-rc.35 (unfold-v0.4.0-rc.35). This record keeps every version Unfold published for Ploeg out of reach of any later Unfold train.

unfold.note: An unfold-v release versions Vloer (ADR-0019). Until 2026-10-03 it versioned Ploeg too (ADR-0004). A bundle that versions neither component needs its own train entry.
